posts.title: Climate deal collapses in chaotic end to COP31 as EU and more reject deal
posts.description: The COP31 climate talks headed for a historic defeat Sunday as a final deal collapsed over a fossil fuel impasse and the summit lurched into record overtime in Turkey.

posts.title: EU proposes tax on Big Tech to boost budget
posts.description: The EU put forward plans to tax the world's biggest digital companies to fund its next budget Saturday, as it seeks to bridge divisions among member states over the bloc's long-term funding.

posts.title: DNI: Ten interesting facts about Spain’s ID document for Spanish nationals
posts.description: Spanish citizens are issued with a ID card called the Documento Nacional de Identidad or DNI. Here are 10 fascinating facts to know about them, from where the first ones were issued to who had number 1.
